name: overlap
title: Overlap GPU and CPU work inside a hybrid decode or verify step (quant, glue, commit)

needs.model_file: any model that runs in the hybrid mode (experts on the CPU pool), e.g. the UD-IQ4_XS file; MTP on (--mtp 2 or 3) for the commit switch

parity_check: Greedy output with and without the lever must be identical: same prompt, same --mtp, compare the token ids. all_verify must end with 'VERIFY_OVERLAP: N comparisons, 0 mismatches'. Model-free: ninja q36_act_quant_parity && ./q36_act_quant_parity (0 mismatches).
notes: Compare tokens per second of all, quant, glue and commit against the lever off from the same thermal state (package at or below 55 C at the start of each run). all_stats prints one timing line per step on stderr: total = GPU wait + host glue + pool + upload/merge enqueue + rest, and the CPU entries against the weight sets read (the sharing across the rows of a verify window); all_verify slows the steps and is a correctness run, not a timing run. With commit the trailing GDN commit is not in the stats line: judge it by tokens per second.
